name: Fittech Co., Ltd.
summary: Fittech Co., Ltd. provides automatic equipment and system integration services in Taiwan, China, Asia, and internationally. The company offers LED/MiniLED test solutions, including LED chip and wafer, auto LED wafer, LED flip chip/wafer, auto flip-chip, auto LED chip probing and testing systems, auto production LED mapping sorters, high accuracy automatic chip counters, and automatic detaching tape systems. It also provides MicroLED test and transfer solutions; auto semiconductor wafer probing systems; and laser cleaning solutions, such as handheld laser, laser cleaning system, and semi-auto probe pin laser cleaners.
